component.name: CardCarousel
component.description: Horizontal exploratory container for homogeneous Card items. Promo carousels support upsell/cross-sell, optional header, snap/free scroll, peek, and a header action when more than two items need a broader view.

antiPatterns.reason: Horizontal scrolling hides priority and weakens conversion.
Carousel is exploratory and should stay homogeneous.

contentRules: Cards in the same carousel should be homogeneous.
Use for discovery, promos, rewards, or features, not critical actions.
Hide component when items is empty.
Render a standalone Card when there is exactly one item.
Show a header button when there are more than two items and a wider destination exists.
For promo carousels, show type labels when selected_content_type is all; hide the type label when a specific content-type filter is selected.
Promo Tractive logic: if has_tractive is false, show upsell; if has_tractive is true, show insights instead.
Personalized promo content must consider pet_name, benefit_eligibility, campaign_id, selected_content_type, and visibility.

rules: CardCarousel contains Card items; never recreate card internals inside carousel.
The optional header action uses Button secondary small.
Show the small secondary Button when there are more than two card actions/items and a wider destination exists.
CardCarousel forces equal row height for all Card instances in the track; Card body expands so metadata/actions align to the bottom.
When a slide needs a task list, pass ActionList as Card `children` inside that item's CardProps; keep other slides visually consistent (promo vs task mix is acceptable for discovery rails).
ContentModule composes CardCarousel for the horizontal track after optional title and filter chips.

Header (title, optional description, optional action) stays within the parent horizontal padding; the scroll track extends past the trailing padding by layout/screen/paddingX plus layout/carousel/peekOutset so the first slide lines up with the same inset as siblings while the next slide visibly peeks on the right.

layout.behavior: Horizontal overflow with optional scroll snap; cards remain independent focus targets.

accessibility.role: region with horizontally scrollable card list
accessibility.keyboardSupport: Each card remains reachable by tab. Native horizontal scroll remains available.
accessibility.screenReader: Reading order follows the Figma documentation annotations: header names the region when present, optional header action, horizontal track, then each Card with its own accessible name.
accessibility.focusManagement: The optional header button is an independent focus before the cards. Each Card remains a separate focus target; the carousel track itself should not hide critical actions.

aiHints.context: Carousel is exploration. If priority is high or required, use ActionList instead.
